_comment: The theme a project draws: its theme_id, else the one its light or dark
`theme` names, a word not named reading as the default `theme`. The project
schema decides it (UISettings in openavc/core/project_loader.py); the panel
generated table. tests/test_blank_theme_parity.py runs every case through the
schema and the panel, builderTheme.test.ts through the Builder. 'settings'
is ui.settings as written; a 'draft_only' case is one the loader refuses
(a null), which only a Builder draft can hand the panel.

cases.name: a dark project with no id
a light project with no id
a light project with the id left out
an id over a light project
an id over a dark project
an id with the light or dark left out
a light or dark left blank
a word the schema does not name
light in capitals is not light
a word that is an object's own property name
a null id in a draft
a null light or dark in a draft
